descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S19 「在 iPhone 和 Android 上真实口述两次就诊，两种模式；说话人切换、语音转文字引擎，以及一台日期错的手机」 Real dictation on iPhone and Android over two visits, both modes; speaker toggle, speech-to-text engine and a phone with the wrong date

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U5 The expanded transcript is correctly attributed: each line shows the right speaker (Physician / Patient), and the transcript sits under the right patient and visit.（UAT TC-16）
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both.（UAT 3.3；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U12 For each real dictation, record the speech-to-text engine that produced the transcript.（UAT 3.9）
  • U9 Time-based rules (what counts as today and yesterday, when a transcript becomes a prior entry, when it leaves) use the server clock. …（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given A native debug build bundled for the local stack (as android-lane.ts does, with 127.0.0.1:4510/4511 routed to the host), or a staging deployment Daniela names; never a store, TestFlight or Play build, which point at dev (, the store-review backend). …

When Visit 1: bedside recording with the Physician / Patient toggle (Hospital) and dictated visit text (Nursing Home). Visit 2 the next day: same. Open Prior Encounter Transcripts and expand. Then set one phone's clock one day ahead, record one line on it and open the panel on both phones

Then Visit 1 is listed without any manual save. Lines show the speaker that was toggled. The STT engine is recorded per dictation (GPT-Live expected). Both phones show the same rows: the wrong-clock line is not filed under another day and yesterday's is not dropped

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Tester compares each expanded line with the script: words, speaker, order (U1, U5). STT engine from aiCallLog read on the same backend the build points at (local: through the local Convex; never query dev) or from the build notes (U12). Wrong-clock step: UAT 3.8, compared with S18; a mismatch is a new finding against TFA-92594, not TFA-92584. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
